jobDescription:
Matillion is building the agentic data team

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding and manual data engineering cannot keep up. Maia is our AI agent for data engineering. It builds and manages the data products teams depend on, multiplying what a whole data team can deliver. Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack already run on it.


We started in Manchester and we are now global, with teams across the UK, US and India, and fifteen years of data expertise behind us. We have raised over $300M from some of the world’s best investors, including General Atlantic, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Battery Ventures.


We move fast, hold a high bar, and sweat the details. If you want to do the best product work of your career on a genuinely hard AI problem, this is the place.



About the Role



As a Senior Product Manager, you will own a significant slice of the Maia product, working at the intersection of complex user problems, AI capability, and commercial impact. We need someone who understands what a great agentic product experience looks like and holds the bar for it relentlessly.


You will be user-obsessed and data-driven in equal measure. You define what success looks like before you build, run evals to hold Maia to a high bar, and use AI in your own workflow to move faster. We're not prescriptive about your background: what matters is that you can move fast like a startup and scale with discipline like a larger company, and you know the difference. Most of all, we're looking for depth: the instinct to get to the heart of a hard problem and own it end to end.


Great product work happens through collaboration. You'll partner closely with Engineering and Design to build Maia, and with GTM to take it to market and turn what you learn into what you build next.


What you will be doing:





  • Own a core area of Maia end to end: define the problems worth solving, prioritise ruthlessly, make the hard trade-offs with incomplete data, and drive the work through to measurable impact.




  • Set the quality bar for agentic behaviour: build the evals that measure how good Maia really is, interrogate the outputs, and hold the line when it isn't there yet.




  • Deeply understand our users: get past feature requests to the real friction in a data team's workflow, and the moments that earn trust.




  • Work at the frontier of the stack: reason with Engineering about models, context, tools like MCP, and orchestration, and where each one changes the product.




  • Accelerate your own output with AI: use AI tools actively across research, synthesis, prototyping, and analysis, always finding ways to move faster without trading away quality.




  • Drive cross-functional alignment: work day to day with Engineering and Design, keep GTM ahead of what's shipping, and present your roadmap and priorities clearly to stakeholders, leadership and customers.





What we are looking for:





  • A track record of shipping and scaling B2B products. You have built, launched, and grown products people love.




  • Real fluency with how modern AI products work. You are familiar with evals, agentic workflows, context, and tools like MCP, and you have clear judgment about where AI earns its place and where it does not.




  • A systems thinker. You see how the pieces fit together and balance craft, speed, and commercial impact.




  • Sharp judgment under ambiguity. You turn incomplete information into crisp decisions, defend them, and change your mind when the evidence changes.




  • Deep data literacy. You are fluent with metrics and let evidence, not opinion, drive the call.




  • Excellent communication. You articulate a clear vision, bring cross-functional teams with you, and present with credibility to leadership and customers.




  • Strong product instincts and taste. You stay close to the user, know what great looks like, and hold the bar for it.




  • Bonus: data domain knowledge. Exposure to data integration, warehousing (Snowflake, Databricks), or analytics is a plus, not a requirement.






At Matillion, we are committed to providing compensation in line with market standards based on the role, job family, job level and country. This role's estimated annual salaried pay range for this position is £76,000 - £114,000. The final salary will be based on your relevant skills, experience and qualifications demonstrated in the hiring process.





More about Matillion


We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work-life balance, with benefits including:




  • Company Equity




  • 30 days holiday + bank holiday




  • 5 days paid volunteering leave




  • Private Health Insurance




  • Life Insurance




  • Pension




  • Access to mental health support





Your Safety


Matillion recruiters will only contact you from @matillion.com email addresses. We occasionally work with trusted recruiting partners; they will always tell you they are working on our behalf. We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to matillion.com/careers to verify open roles or reach us at talent@matillion.com.


Want to know more?


Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.


Cannot find anything suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at talent@matillion.com.


Find out more about life on #TeamGreen here. 


Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team. Department: Product

Location: Cardiff

Hybrid: 2 days per week in our Cardiff office


Confused.com

Confused.com is the UK’s first comparison platform for car insurance. We’ve been helping customers since 2002 by empowering them to make better decisions around insurance and financial services.

We’re part of RVU, a group of online brands that include: Uswitch, Tempcover, money.co.uk, and Mojo Mortgages. We are at the cutting edge of the FinTech industry, so we’re always looking for extraordinary talent. If you love what you do, get in touch today!


About The Role

We’re looking for an experienced Product Manager to drive forward our capabilities to improve the customer experience across Confused.com. You will shape and define the product strategy for your area, using the latest technologies and product tools to identify, shape and deliver innovative data-driven experiences that our new and returning customers love, want to share and repeat.


You’ll work closely with a team of engineers, analysts and designers, as well as others across the business to identify and deliver on opportunities to deepen customer relationships, increasing engagement, conversion, product holding, loyalty and customer lifetime value.


You'll work within our wider one-platform, multi-channel strategy, ensuring your product area's journey is joined up across Web, Mobile App and CRM.


What you'll be doing

Strategy

  • Defining, owning, and driving the strategy for an insurance comparison product (e.g. Car, Home, Travel, Life, Pet, Bike).
  • Responsible for ensuring good customer outcomes are achieved in line with industry regulations across the end-to-end journey.
  • Leading discovery and supporting delivery to improve user experiences, constructively challenging assumptions to ensure we focus on the most valuable opportunities.
  • Identifying opportunities to grow the product through differentiated and tailored experiences.
  • Coordinating with platform teams to achieve the outcomes needed for your product area.

Delivery

  • Using data and customer insights to identify and realise opportunities for your product area, defining appropriate measures and articulating performance
  • Championing customers needs, balancing customer outcomes with business goals for your product area
  • Collaborating with colleagues across engineering, design, marketing and commercial, to implement the product roadmap.
  • Supporting the management of external service providers to deliver the required outcomes
  • Proactively identifying and addressing risks, escalating where necessary to keep delivery on track


What We're Looking For

  • 2-4 years Product Management experience.
  • Experience of running discovery within a team of Product, Engineering, Design and Analytics.
  • A bias to action and ability to ‘get stuff done’, making every day count (Urgency)
  • Commercially astute with a strong critical thinking and the ability to find insights others haven’t
  • Resilience and adaptability - comfortable with ambiguity, and confident navigating complex challenges
  • Good understanding of human-centred design principles and how they apply to digital customer experiences
  • Good communication skills, able to adapt style for different audiences and build buy-in within your team
  • Experience working with external suppliers and partners to deliver on shared objectives


Our commitment to you

We are dedicated to developing valuable, inclusive, and user-friendly products and services that deliver positive outcomes for all of our customers. To achieve this, it’s essential that our teams reflect the diverse range of people in our community. We believe in being the change we wish to see in the world, by embracing our differences and holding ourselves accountable to being open and inclusive teammates and wider community members.


What We Offer

We want to give you a great work environment, support your growth both personally and professionally, and provide benefits that make your time at RVU even more enjoyable. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • 10% discretionary yearly bonus and yearly pay reviews (based on RVU and personal performance)
  • A hybrid working approach with 2 in-office days per week and up to 22 working days per year to “work from anywhere”
  • Employer matching pension contributions up to 7.5%
  • A one-off £300 “work from home” budget to help contribute towards a great work environment at home
  • Excellent maternity, paternity, shared parental, and adoption leave policy, for those key moments in your life
  • 25 days holiday (increasing to 30 days) + 2 days “my time” per year
  • Private medical cover, critical illness cover, dental plans, and employee assistance programme
  • Free gym access
  • Employee discounts programme
  • A healthy learning and training budget to support your development
  • Electric vehicle and cycle to work schemes
  • Regular events - from team socials to company-wide events with insightful external speakers, we want to make sure our colleagues continue to feel connected.

We're ASOS. We blend our flair for fashion with our love of cutting- edge technology, but more importantly were interested in how we can bring the best out of you.

We exist to give people the confidence to be whoever they want to be, and that goes for our people too. At ASOS, you're free to be your true self without judgment, and channel your creativity into a platform used by millions.



Job Description

Digital Product at ASOS

At ASOS, we’re proud to be a global fashion destination serving over 23 million active customers across more than 100 markets with 2.5 billion visits annually. Our Tech team is at the heart of everything we do, powering the digital experiences that make ASOS a leader in online fashion retail. We operate as a product-led organisation, where cross-functional teams are empowered to solve real customer problems through innovation, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making. With a strong focus on scalability, personalisation, and cutting-edge technology, we’re building the future of fashion commerce. 

The Details

This role is for a Senior Product Manager in the CRM team, as part of Digital Product and will report to our Head of Product – CRM and Lifecycle Product. At ASOS, CRM is one of our most important customer engagement channels, delivering email and push notifications to our customers around the world, and we’re looking for someone to lead the next generation of personalised customer communications. This role will shape the products and capabilities that determine how, when and why customers hear from ASOS. You'll help us move beyond traditional campaign-led communications towards intelligent, customer-centric experiences that are personalised, relevant and timely.

You’ll be the focal point of a dedicated and cross-functional squad setting big, ambitious goals, and you’ll have the freedom to decide how to meet these. You’ll have a growth mindset and a can-do attitude and relish the autonomous culture. As a natural storyteller, you’ll build solid narratives and will take your stakeholders on the journey throughout.  You will be passionate about the customer and always lead with data insights when making decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the product vision and roadmap for CRM, focused on improving engagement and long-term value
  • Drive the strategy for intelligent customer communications
  • Support creating an always-on testing environment, improving how we measure incrementality and customer impact
  • Stay informed and be responsible for surfacing competitor and industry wide trends and sharing these with the wider CRM team
  • Partner with design, marketing, engineering, and other parts of the business to build high-quality, engaging, and exciting UX that delight our customers
  • Collaborate with and influence other areas of the business to create personalisation strategies that enhance engagement, loyalty, and conversion
  • Use customer research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and measure impact. And run A/B tests and build data driven dashboards / conduct analysis to shape next steps

Qualifications

About You 

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager in e-commerce, fashion, or consumer-facing platforms
  • Strong track record in launching 0-1 mobile-first products, ideally with focus in personalisation
  • Familiarity with how enriched customer data powers the user journey to deliver contextually relevant content and experiences
  • Comfortable working in agile, full stack, cross-functional teams
  • Data-driven mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using tools like Power BI, Braze, Databricks and Optimizely
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities

Additional Information

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive salary, pension, and private medical care scheme
  • Performance related bonus
  • Flex benefits allowance - which you can chose to take as extra cash, or use towards other benefits
  • 25 days paid annual leave + an extra day for your birthday
  • Employee discount (hello ASOS discount!)
  • Tech Develops - our internal tech focussed skills development programme to focus on your personal growth as a technologist
  • Opportunity to represent ASOS at industry leading events
  • Opportunity to help shape and drive our DE&I initiatives
  • Opportunity to make an impact from day one and work with the latest in cutting edge of technology

jobTitle: Senior Product Manager, Global FX & Cross-Border Issuer Solutions
jobDescription:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Global FX and Cross-Border Solutions team is charged with leading the strategy, design, build, and commercialization of best-in-class flexible enterprise-wide FX and Cross-Border solutions as we seek to meet the growing and increasingly diversified needs of clients moving funds around the world.

What’s it all about?

The Senior Product Manager, Global FX & Cross-Border Issuer Solutions is responsible for defining and executing the roadmap for issuer-focused FX and Cross-Border capabilities, driving product strategy from concept through execution while partnering closely with technology, operations and regional stakeholders. The successful candidate will leverage deep knowledge of Visa capabilities and systems, while translating business objectives into scalable product solutions through detailed requirements, transaction flows, prototypes and technical designs. The role requires strong product thinking and commercial acumen, with the ability to evaluate and prioritise product investments, balancing client needs, technical feasibility and strategic objectives to ensure resources are focused on the initiatives that deliver the greatest client, commercial and long-term business value.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Gen AI tools (e.g. Replit, Copilot, Figma AI, Claude Code etc) to enable everyday work.

What We Expect Of You, Day To Day.

Product Design & Solution Architecture

  • Own and manage the development of customer-centric product requirements for issuer FX and multicurrency solutions by leveraging AI-powered tools to rapidly define, iterate, validate, and refine product concepts. Transform client needs, market opportunities, and business objectives into prioritized requirements, AI-generated prototypes, workflow-models, user stories, process flows, and scalable solution designs using AI tools.
  • Design end-to-end solutions that align business objectives, client requirements and technical capabilities.
  • Develop transaction flow diagrams, system interaction models, wireframes and solution prototypes to support product development and stakeholder alignment.
  • Drive requirements gathering and translate complex business problems into clear and actionable technical requirements.
  • Work with Technology, Processing and Architecture teams to assess solution feasibility, dependencies and implementation considerations.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to convert strategic product opportunities into scalable technical solutions.
  • Lead client workshops, design sessions, solution reviews and architecture discussions throughout the product lifecycle, translating market and client needs into validated product concepts and scalable technical solutions that support successful delivery.

Product Strategy & Portfolio Prioritisation

  • Contribute to the development and execution of the Global FX & Cross-Border Issuer and multicurrency product strategy.
  • Identify strategic opportunities through client engagement, market research, competitive analysis and industry developments.
  • Evaluate product initiatives and investment opportunities based on client value, commercial potential, technical feasibility, implementation complexity, scalability and strategic alignment.
  • Develop business cases, market assessments and value frameworks to support investment and prioritisation decisions.
  • Partner with regional, commercial and product teams to gather market insights and validate investment opportunities.
  • Assess build, buy and partner opportunities to address product capability gaps, recommending the optimal approach based on strategic, commercial and technical considerations, and supporting partnership commercials, contracting and execution.
  • Recommend product roadmap priorities, sequencing and investment allocation based on expected business impact, resource constraints and strategic objectives.
  • Support annual planning, portfolio reviews and investment discussions with senior leadership.
  • Monitor product performance, adoption and commercial outcomes, using Gen AI and data-driven insights to refine strategy and prioritise future investments.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of the payments ecosystem, including issuer processing, FX mechanics, multicurrency solutions and cross-border transaction flows.
  • Demonstrated experience working with payment processing platforms and technologies, including VIP, BASE II, authorisation, clearing, settlement and transaction lifecycle management.
  • Experience designing and documenting complex solutions through BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process maps, transaction flows and solution design documentation.
  • Experience working with multi-currency, wallet, FX or banking platforms such as Currencycloud is highly desirable.
  • 5-8+ years of experience in product management, technical product management, payments, FX, multicurrency solutions, issuer processing or cross-border payments.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements, solve complex business and technical problems, and translate them into scalable product solutions.
  • Experience partnering with Technology, Processing, Operations and Architecture teams to deliver product enhancements and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience supporting product roadmap development, business case creation, revenue drivers, financial models and portfolio prioritisation.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking and prioritisation skills, with the ability to assess opportunities based on client value, commercial impact, technical feasibility and strategic alignment.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both business and technical audiences.
  • Experience working within global, matrixed organisations and collaborating across regional and cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% (regional and global).

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Before you apply: this role requires recent, hands-on experience owning a workforce, resource or crew scheduling product (things like shift scheduling, time & attendance, capacity planning or absence management) as a genuine Product Manager or Product Owner, not a Business Analyst, Programme Manager or delivery lead working to someone else's requirements.

If your closest match to this domain was a short stint, or is more than a few years back, this likely isn't the right role for you.

Job Description

People, skills and operational resources are critical to success in construction, engineering and other project-driven industries. Organisations must balance productivity, compliance, utilisation and cost while ensuring the right resources are available at the right time.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to contribute to the strategy, discovery and delivery of operational workforce and resource management solutions for Construction & Engineering and adjacent industries.

You will drive product initiatives from discovery through adoption, working closely with customers, engineering, design and industry experts to validate opportunities, build business cases and deliver measurable outcomes.

Based in the United Kingdom, the role has a global remit across North America, Europe and APMJA. You will work closely with customers, partners and internal teams to identify opportunities, validate needs and deliver solutions that create measurable business value.

This role requires strong product leadership, strategic thinking and a passion for applying AI, automation and emerging technologies to solve complex workforce and operational challenges.

What You Will Do

Contribute to Product Strategy

  • Contribute to product strategy and shape roadmaps for designated product domains and investments.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends and industry insight into focused investments.
  • Balance customer value, commercial opportunity and platform evolution.
  • Deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

Drive Customer and Market Discovery

  • Engage directly with customers to understand challenges, priorities and outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships with customers, partners and industry experts.
  • Validate opportunities before investment decisions are made.
  • Establish design partners and lighthouse customers to support discovery and adoption.

Define the Product

  • Translate customer problems into product outcomes, experiences and success measures.
  • Drive prototyping, validation and iterative discovery.
  • Partner closely with engineering and design teams.
  • Leverage AI to accelerate discovery, innovation and product definition.

Deliver Outcomes

  • Build evidence-led investment cases.
  • Drive initiatives from discovery through adoption.
  • Support positioning, launch and customer engagement.
  • Measure success through adoption, customer outcomes and business impact.

Shape the Future of Workforce Management

  • Champion an AI-first mindset, identifying how automation, intelligence and agentic experiences can transform workforce-intensive industries.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify work through intelligent automation.
  • Explore new interaction models and user experiences.
  • Ensure AI-enabled capabilities deliver trusted, measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with customers to shape the next generation of workforce experiences on IFS Cloud.

Qualifications

Essential Experience

  • Product management experience delivering SaaS, workforce management, resource management, field service or enterprise software solutions.
  • Experience contributing to product strategy, roadmaps, discovery, delivery and adoption.
  • Experience with workforce planning, scheduling, time and attendance, resource management, labour compliance, payroll integration or workforce analytics.
  • Understanding of operationally intensive industries such as Construction & Engineering, Energy, Utilities, Manufacturing, Telecommunications or Field Service.
  • Experience working with global customers
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and customer engagement skills.
  • Experience working closely with engineering and design teams.
  • Fluent English and willingness to travel internationally.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with workforce management, resource planning, scheduling, payroll, HCM or operational workforce solutions.
  • Experience within construction, engineering, energy, utilities, manufacturing or other project-centric industries.
  • Understanding of workforce productivity, compliance, payroll and workforce analytics.
  • Experience building AI-enabled enterprise software products.
  • Familiarity with AI, automation and agentic experiences.
  • Experience modernising enterprise SaaS products.
  • Exposure to business case development, pricing, monetisation or product P&L ownership.
  • Experience establishing design partner or customer co-innovation programmes.
  • Degree or equivalent experience in business, engineering, computer science or a related discipline.

How You Will Work

You will succeed in this role if you are:

  • Customer obsessed, focused on solving meaningful problems.
  • Outcome driven, prioritising impact over feature delivery.
  • Strategic and commercially minded, balancing customer value with business growth.
  • Industry aware, understanding operational and project-driven organisations.
  • Innovative, embracing AI and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborative, working effectively across product, engineering, design and go-to-market teams.
  • Technically fluent, comfortable discussing data, integrations, platforms and AI.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, bringing clarity to complex challenges.
  • Hands-on, actively engaging in discovery, validation and customer conversations.
  • A multiplier, helping raise the bar for product management.

Additional Information

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

Job Description

Are you looking for an opportunity to build products that are changing the way we audit? The Senior Product Manager, Audit role leads the delivery of end-to-end product experiences across our core audit product portfolio.

Your mission will be to help shape and deliver the next generation of audit workflows, creating AI-native, intuitive, and high-value experiences across the products and capabilities our customers rely on every day. This role operates within a fast-moving team that is rapidly adopting AI-based ways of working to improve speed, clarity, and execution quality.

Key Responsibilities

In this role as Senior Product Manager, you will:

  • As a Senior Product Manager, no two days are alike. You will engage with customers to understand their workflows, advocate for their needs internally, refine product strategy, define success metrics, prioritize roadmap investments, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes.
  • Own the vision, direction, and priorities for a strategic area of the audit product portfolio
  • Translate customer needs into clear product requirements and compelling roadmaps
  • Partner closely with engineering and design to deliver high-quality, reliable audit workflows
  • Use data, customer insight, and experimentation to guide prioritization and iteration
  • Take strong ownership of product outcomes, performance, and customer experience
  • Contribute to a high-performing product culture and mentor junior PMs when needed

You are customer-obsessed, outcome-oriented, and comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. You bring strong judgment, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively across teams.

Required Qualifications

You're a strong fit for the role of Senior Product Manager, if your background includes:

  • 4+ years of Product Management experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, business, computer science, or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Analytics experience is a plus
  • Direct experience in audit, audit technology, or adjacent domains strongly preferred

What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

jobTitle: Senior Product Manager - Series C Fintech
jobDescription:
Help us build the Homeownership category in fintech.


Tembo is one of the UK's fastest-growing fintechs, helping people save for, buy and own a home. Hundreds of thousands of customers already use Tembo to save and plan for their future, while our mortgage business has grown into one of the UK's leading digital brokers, voted the UK's Best Mortgage Broker five years in a row.


Today, our app is predominantly a savings experience, with mortgages integrated into the journey. We're now bringing those strengths together to build the defining financial platform for homeownership: helping customers save, understand what they can afford, get mortgage-ready, buy their home and make smarter financial decisions throughout homeownership.


We're looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager to own our Savings app and play a major role in making that happen.


This is a high-accountability individual contributor role. You'll have genuine ownership of one of Tembo's most important product areas, working directly with our founders and alongside engineering, design, data, marketing and commercial teams.


You'll be expected to make meaningful product bets, move quickly and be accountable for the outcomes. You'll own the Savings experience we have today while helping define what it becomes next, including how we bring Savings and Mortgages closer together and use AI to deliver personalised homeownership guidance at scale.


The opportunity

You'll take ownership of a significant consumer product already used by hundreds of thousands of customers, spanning our Lifetime ISA, Cash ISA and HomeSaver® - our market-leading and unique savings product built specifically around homeownership.


But this role is about much more than optimising the Savings product we have today.


You'll help answer some of the biggest product questions at Tembo:

  • How do we help customers understand whether they're on track to buy a home?
  • How do we connect saving and getting mortgage-ready into one seamless journey?
  • How can AI give every customer genuinely useful, personalised guidance on what they should do next?
  • What new products and experiences should we build that don't exist today?


You'll have the autonomy to identify the opportunities, make the bets and the accountability to prove whether they work.


What you'll do

  • Own the Savings product. Take accountability for its strategy, roadmap, customer experience and commercial performance.
  • Make meaningful product bets. Identify opportunities that can materially change growth, engagement or customer outcomes and build the conviction to pursue them.
  • Shape our Homeownership strategy. Help define how Savings, Mortgages and new experiences come together into a more powerful consumer proposition.
  • Shape our consumer AI strategy. Identify where AI can fundamentally improve the way we guide customers and turn those opportunities into real products.
  • Drive growth and engagement. Find ways to help more customers choose Tembo, save more with us and engage more deeply with the product.
  • Set the direction. Identify the problems worth solving and make clear prioritisation decisions rather than managing a pre-defined backlog.
  • Lead cross-functionally. Bring engineering, design, data, marketing and commercial teams together around clear customer problems and outcomes.
  • Get close to customers and data. Build conviction through customer insight, behavioural data and commercial performance.
  • Move quickly and learn. Take ideas from ambiguous problems through discovery, validation, build and launch, then iterate based on what actually happens.
  • Own the outcome. Success isn't shipping the roadmap. It's delivering measurable impact for our customers and the business.


What we're looking for

We're looking for a senior product person who wants ownership rather than management.


You'll likely have:

  • Significant experience building and scaling consumer-facing digital products.
  • A track record of owning meaningful product areas and delivering measurable customer and commercial outcomes.
  • Experience making significant product bets, not just optimising an existing roadmap.
  • Excellent product judgement and a strong instinct for what makes a brilliant consumer experience.
  • The ability to take ambiguous problems, form a strong point of view and turn that into action.
  • Strong analytical instincts and confidence using data to make decisions.
  • Experience working closely with engineering and design teams from discovery through to delivery.
  • A strong point of view on how AI is changing consumer products and the curiosity to turn new capabilities into experiences customers genuinely value.
  • Strong commercial thinking and an understanding of the relationship between customer value and business value.
  • The confidence to challenge founders and senior stakeholders, while knowing when to make a decision, commit and execute.


Experience in fintech, savings, investing or mortgages would be useful, but it isn't essential. We're more interested in people who have built brilliant consumer products and can bring that experience to Tembo.


What this role isn't

This isn't a role where you'll be handed requirements and asked to manage a delivery backlog.

And it isn't a people-management role. Seniority here comes from scope, judgement and accountability, not the number of Product Managers reporting to you. We're looking for someone who wants to be close to the product, customers and data, make difficult decisions and be on the hook for whether they work.


Why Tembo?

This is an opportunity to own a significant consumer product at scale while having an unusually large influence over where it goes next.


You'll join a business with real scale across both Savings and Mortgages, but with a huge amount still to build as we bring those worlds together.


You'll have huge autonomy, huge accountability and direct access to our founders, with the opportunity to make product bets that can materially shape both Tembo and how people navigate homeownership in the UK.


Package

The package includes competitive salary and equity options.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

  • Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
  • Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
  • If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Design in partnership with the Security team, credential management, authentication strategies, and secure connection protocols that balance security with developer experience.
  • Build and improve webhook reliability, observability, and usability.
  • Deliver API and webhook logs and diagnostics tooling that helps partners and internal teams investigate and recover from issues faster.
  • Ensure the auth and security infrastructure of Wise Platform is robust and scalable for the long term service demands.

In this role, you will;

Own the roadmap

  • Define and execute a roadmap centred on secure access, reliability, and operational excellence in production.

Drive execution

  • Work closely with engineering to ship improvements that measurably reduce incidents, support load, and time-to-resolution.

Collaborate cross-functionally

Deliver impact

  • Deliver measurable reductions in partner-impacting incidents, improved troubleshooting speed, and stronger security posture that supports enterprise adoption.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 6+ years of product management experience, ideally with APIs, platform products, security, identity, auth or infrastructure.

Technical aptitude

  • Strong understanding of authentication and access patterns (e.g., OAuth2, API keys, JOSE, mTLS), identity/access lifecycle, and operational reliability concepts.
  • Comfortable discussing architecture, threat/risk trade-offs, and reliability/observability with engineers.

Customer-centric mindset

  • Empathy for partner developers and operators; you can translate production pain into clear product priorities and outcomes.

Analytical & data-driven

  • Able to set measurable goals and use metrics and incident data to drive prioritisation and iteration.

Execution-focused

  • Track record of shipping impactful platform improvements in complex, cross-functional environments.

Strong communication & collaboration

  • Can clearly communicate technical topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders, build alignment, and drive decisions.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy and evolution of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform. In this role, you'll shape the vision for a business-critical product that supports teams across Finance, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Project Operations. You'll connect business priorities with technology investment, helping colleagues work more effectively while improving data quality, governance and decision making across the organisation.


What you’ll be doing

  • Define and communicate a clear vision, strategy and roadmap for Dynamics 365 across Kantar.
  • Lead product direction across Finance, CRM and Project Operations, ensuring teams are aligned on priorities and outcomes.
  • Work closely with Technology, Operations and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable solutions.
  • Prioritise platform investments using user insight, operational performance data and business value.
  • Drive platform enhancements, integrations and continuous improvement initiatives from discovery through to adoption.
  • Improve workflows, automation, reporting and dashboards to create a better experience for users.
  • Strengthen governance, platform standards and data quality across Dynamics 365 and the Microsoft Power Platform.
  • Measure adoption, performance and business impact to inform future product decisions.


The ideal skills & experience


We're looking for someone who combines product leadership expertise with deep knowledge of enterprise business platforms.


You'll likely bring:

  • Significant experience leading enterprise product strategies and roadmaps.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365, particularly Finance, Sales, Customer Relationship Management, Customer Insights or Project Operations.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Power Platform technologies, including Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse.
  • The ability to use data and evidence to prioritise investment decisions and influence stakeholders.
  • Experience delivering change across complex, global organisations.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to align technical and non-technical audiences around a shared vision.
  • A collaborative approach and a passion for improving how people work through technology.


Join us to shape the future of CRM at the heart of Kantar’s technology transformation.


Please be aware, the majority of our roles are hybrid, working one to two days a week in our office.


We’re not able to offer visa sponsorship or help with relocation support for this role. Please make sure you’ve got the right to work in the country where this role is located before applying.


What’s in it for you


  • Flexible hybrid working
  • 25 days leave, 2 days paid for volunteering and life event leave
  • Competitive salary and bonus (bonus dependent on role)
  • Company pension
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Healthcare options
  • Wide range of flexible benefits


Why join Kantar?


Kantar is one of the most recognised and trusted brands in its industry, with unmatched depth of experience and global reach. What makes this moment different is how much is changing at once.


We are working on the world’s most influential brands, investing in AI and technology, and evolving how intelligence is delivered. The work is becoming more connected, more dynamic and more impactful.


People joining Kantar now are not stepping into something finished. They are joining a business that is evolving, and they will help shape what comes next.


If you want to work on iconic brands, solve complex problems, learn from exceptional people and do work that genuinely makes a difference, we would love to hear from you.

jobDescription:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

The Customer Contact Experience, or CCX, Product Manager has end-to-end accountability for the business and technology success of EY’s global cloud contact center service. The role develops and communicates the product vision and roadmap, translating business priorities into the technical roadmap while ensuring the service remains desirable, viable, functional, secure, reliable, compliant and cost-effective.

The Product Manager leads collaboration across business stakeholders, engineering, operations, architecture, security, privacy, procurement, finance, risk and external suppliers. The role covers the full product lifecycle, from requirements and investment decisions through delivery, adoption, service operation and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and communicate the CCX business product vision, strategy and roadmap, ensuring that business priorities and desired value drive the technical product roadmap and service offerings.
  • Act as the voice of the customer and principal point of contact for business stakeholders, engineering, operations and other product teams.
  • Gather, validate and prioritize business requirements, feature requests, technical improvements and regulatory obligations.
  • Manage the product backlog and lead cross-functional delivery from concept through design, testing, release and operational readiness.
  • Oversee service performance, incidents, problems, capacity, business continuity, disaster recovery and continuous improvement.
  • Manage Genesys and other technology suppliers, including roadmap alignment, service reviews, escalations, contracts, licensing and commercial discussions.
  • Maintain oversight of product costs, forecasts, licensing consumption and investment requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with EY security, privacy, data retention, records management, supplier risk and Responsible AI requirements.
  • Coordinate required architecture, security, privacy and risk assessments for new capabilities and integrations.
  • Define and monitor product KPIs covering service performance, adoption, customer satisfaction, cost and delivery outcomes.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Ability to lead a multi-disciplinary global team through the product lifecycle, create clarity across business and technical stakeholders, and drive a product mindset with limited supervision.
  • Strong customer focus with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technical outcomes.
  • Excellent stakeholder, supplier, communication, negotiation and decision-making skills.
  • Strong analytical, commercial and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to balance customer value, cost, operational stability, technical feasibility, risk and compliance.

Vialto Partners is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to ‘Connect the world’. We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.

Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.

Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 8000 staff worldwide and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.

Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.

To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram.

Job Description

As a Product Manager / Senior Product Manager, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering innovative digital products that support Vialto’s global mobility services. You will work at the intersection of business, technology and customer experience, turning complex business challenges and customer needs into products and solutions that deliver measurable value.

Working closely with Engineering, Technology, Design, Data and Global Mobility specialists, you will own the product lifecycle from discovery and strategy through to delivery, launch and continuous improvement.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing global organization and help shape the future of technology-enabled Global Mobility.

What You'll Do

  • Own and develop product vision, strategy and roadmap in alignment with Vialto’s business objectives and client needs.
  • Work closely with Product, Technology, Engineering, Design, Data and Global Mobility stakeholders to identify opportunities and define product priorities.
  • Translate customer needs, business requirements and market insights into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Lead product discovery activities, identifying customer problems and validating potential solutions.
  • Manage and prioritise the product backlog based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility and strategic priorities.
  • Lead products through the full lifecycle, from ideation and discovery through development, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Engineering and Technical Leads to translate product vision into scalable, secure and effective technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with UX/UI teams to create intuitive, accessible and engaging user experiences.
  • Use data, customer feedback and market insights to measure product performance and inform product decisions.
  • Define and monitor product KPIs and success measures, ensuring products deliver meaningful customer and business outcomes.
  • Work with QA and delivery teams to ensure products meet quality standards and are delivered effectively.
  • Engage with clients and internal stakeholders to understand challenges, gather feedback and validate product concepts.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional and international teams to ensure successful product delivery and deployment.
  • Identify and manage product risks, dependencies and delivery challenges.
  • Contribute to Agile ways of working, including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives and product reviews.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies, industry developments and trends within Global Mobility to identify opportunities for innovation.
  • Participate in product and design reviews, promoting high standards and continuous improvement.
  • For Senior Product Managers, provide coaching and support to Product Managers and contribute to the development of product management practices across Vialto.

What we're looking for

We are looking for a customer-focused, commercially minded and collaborative Product Manager who is passionate about technology, innovation and solving complex business problems.

You Will Ideally Have

  • Proven experience in Product Management, Digital Product Management or a similar product-focused role.
  • Experience managing products through the full product lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of product strategy, discovery, roadmap development and prioritisation.
  • Experience translating business and customer requirements into clear product specifications and user stories.
  • Experience working closely with Engineering, Technology, UX/UI, Data and QA teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A strong customer-centric mindset and understanding of user experience principles.
  • Experience using data and customer insights to inform product decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working within an Agile environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, global organisation.
  • A proactive approach to identifying opportunities and driving continuous improvement.
  • A genuine interest in technology, innovation and the future of Global Mobility.

Senior Product Manager

For the Senior Product Manager level, we would additionally expect:

  • Significant experience owning complex products, platforms or product portfolios.
  • Proven experience developing and executing product strategy across multiple teams or business areas.
  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders and operating effectively at both strategic and operational levels.
  • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to connect product strategy to measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience mentoring or developing Product Managers.
  • A track record of delivering measurable customer, operational or commercial impact through product innovation.

At Vialto Partners, you will be part of a truly global and dynamic team, working with colleagues and clients across different industries and geographical locations.

We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers. Through our global organisation, you will have opportunities to broaden your skills, collaborate across markets and work on products that have a meaningful impact on our clients and their people.

Vialto is committed to creating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. We encourage our people to bring their true selves, share their unique talents and expertise, and make a positive impact on the communities we serve.

Vialto is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Welcome to the future of cloud networking and security!

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cato Networks is building Product-Led Growth capabilities that complement its established enterprise, direct-sales, and partner-led business.

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own product-led customer journeys across Cato’s target markets, with a particular focus on SMB while also improving how larger enterprise customers discover, evaluate, activate, adopt, and expand Cato.

For SMB customers, this may include highly self-service journeys from signup and onboarding through value realization, purchase, and expansion. For larger enterprises, PLG will complement the sales-led motion by helping customers experience value sooner, adopt more effectively, identify expansion opportunities, and create stronger product-qualified demand.

This is an individual-contributor role. You will own measurable customer and business outcomes, working directly with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Channel, Customer Success, and Business Operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and improve the end-to-end PLG journey across relevant customer segments: discover → evaluate → activate → experience value → adopt → convert → retain → expand.
  • Define segment-specific product-led journeys for SMB and enterprise customers, balancing self-service, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted experiences.
  • For SMB, drive simple self-service onboarding, guided configuration, sensible defaults, in-product education, packaging, upgrade paths, and purchase experiences.
  • For enterprise customers, identify ways to accelerate evaluation, activation, time-to-value, adoption, product-qualified demand, and expansion.
  • Define the key activation and “aha” moments for different customer segments, and improve time-to-first-value and unassisted or assisted activation.
  • Own product requirements related to trials, free experiences where relevant, packaging, entitlements, upgrade paths, pricing UX, purchase flows, and conversion triggers.
  • Define, instrument, and monitor PLG metrics, including activation, time-to-first-value, product adoption, conversion, product-qualified opportunities, retention, and expansion.
  • Use product analytics, customer research, funnel analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, test hypotheses, and continuously improve outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Channel, Customer Success, Finance, and Business Operations to create seamless product-led, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted journeys.
  • Identify product-usage and behavioral signals that can trigger contextual recommendations, expansion opportunities, partner engagement, or sales outreach.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS.
  • Deep understanding of Product-Led Growth, including SaaS metrics, freemium and trial models, and PLG-driven customer journeys.
  • Strong experience defining and delivering user-facing product experiences, with a solid understanding of UI/UX principles.
  • Background or strong familiarity with networking and security technologies is an Advantage .
  • Understanding of the SMB networking and security market, including customer needs and the services these customers typically purchase.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.

Success Recruit are currently working with a leading supplier within the construction industry who are seeking to recruit a Product Lead to join their growing and well-established team based in London. This position will suit someone who loves working in a fast-paced and innovative environment where my client continues to expand on quality and being a leader.

The successful Product Lead will be an integral part of the product development team, supporting with the continued strategy for product, price, performance & quality strategy, working within a highly innovative environment and closely with R&D Teams.

The Successful Product Lead Will Be Expected To Have:

  • A degree in business, engineering, or related field
  • 5 years+ of product management experience
  • Strong understanding of European & UK markets & distribution models
  • Proven experience of end-to-end product life cycle management
  • Excellent financial and analytical acumen

The Successful Product Lead Will Be Rewarded With:

  • The opportunity to join an established global brand
  • Work within a developed, established and growing team
  • Modern office environment / 3-4 days office, 1-2days WFH
  • Company bonus scheme

Job Description

The Product Lead will work closely with the wider teams to include sales, marketing, engineering and supply chain to ensure the continued success and growth of product development, lifecycle management and market positioning. The position will require someone to conduct regional market insights for global product strategy ensuring it is aligned with customer and business goals.

Duties To Include But Not Limited To:

  • Conduct in-depth market and competitor analysis
  • Align product plans with corporate objectives, ensuring market-fit and profitability targets are met
  • Oversee the full lifecycle of products from concept to discontinuation
  • Make data-driven decisions to rationalise SKUs and optimize product mix
  • Analyse customer insights & industry trends
  • Partner with local sales teams to validate market requirements and unmet needs
  • Lead product development initiatives, collaborating with global R&D

  • Facilitate meetings to streamline communication and eliminate project bottlenecks
  • Ensure sales and distributor teams are equipped with the necessary training and materials

  • Regularly meet with key distributors, end users, and trade professionals to gather feedback
  • Represent the company at shows and customer events to build brand loyalty
  • Ensure all products meet EU/UK regulatory and safety standards prior to launch
  • Work with QA and legal teams to proactively address compliance risks
  • Conduct post-launch reviews to identify lessons learned and improve future processes

This position will suit someone who thrives in an innovative working environment and that thrives taking ownership and challenging the norm.

We're looking for a strategic and customer-focused Product Manager to lead the evolution of our nCode DesignLife and GlyphWorks software suite. This role is pivotal in defining and supporting the development of industry-leading durability, fatigue, and engineering data analytics solutions that deliver exceptional value to our customers and the business.

As Product Manager, you will work closely with customers, application engineers, software developers, and portfolio leadership to shape the future of our durability and reliability offerings while ensuring alignment with broader business objectives and technology strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for nCode DesignLife and GlyphWorks, aligning customer needs, market opportunities, and business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, and Engineering teams to define, prioritize, and deliver capabilities that provide measurable customer value.
  • Engage directly with customers, industry partners, and key stakeholders to understand workflows, validate requirements, and identify emerging market trends.
  • Define and communicate product strategy, ensuring transparency and alignment across internal teams, sales channels, and portfolio leadership.
  • Support PI Planning and Inspect & Adapt events, providing product context, priorities, and feedback to Scrum teams and the Agile Release Train (ART).
  • Represent the voice of the customer throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring solutions meet the needs of durability engineers, simulation analysts, test engineers, and data scientists.
  • Collaborate with product marketing and sales teams to develop positioning, messaging, training, and go-to-market activities for new releases and strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor product performance, adoption, and customer satisfaction, using data and feedback to drive continuous improvement.
  • Champion innovation and technical excellence, ensuring nCode remains a market leader in fatigue analysis, durability engineering, and engineering data analytics.
  • Drive integration strategy across the wider HBK software portfolio and key technology partners, supporting connected engineering workflows from simulation through testing and reliability.

Qualifications

  • Extensive experience with nCode DesignLife, GlyphWorks, durability engineering, fatigue analysis, or related engineering software solutions.
  • Strong understanding of fatigue methods, durability validation processes, CAE-driven design, test data analysis, and engineering simulation workflows.
  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Proven experience in product management, application engineering, durability engineering, or a related technical leadership role.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear product direction.
  • Experience working with Agile development methodologies and cross-functional software development teams.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to engage effectively with customers, partners, and internal leadership.
  • Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with fatigue and durability standards, including strain-life, stress-life, vibration fatigue, and multiaxial fatigue methodologies.
  • Knowledge of simulation-driven development processes and CAE tools such as Ansys, Abaqus, Nastran, OptiStruct, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with engineering test data acquisition, processing, and analysis methodologies.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based engineering workflows, digital engineering platforms, and modern software architectures.
  • Experience presenting at industry conferences, customer forums, or user group meetings.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to shape the future of industry-leading engineering software used by automotive, aerospace, transportation, energy, and industrial organizations around the world. You will work alongside highly skilled engineers and software professionals while helping customers design safer, more reliable, and more durable products.

We Offer

At HBK, we believe in freedom with responsibility. We offer a flexible and collaborative work environment that supports both professional growth and work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work with modern technologies, influence technical direction, and help shape the future of software engineering within a global technology leader.

About HBK

On January 1, 2019, Brüel & Kjær and HBM merged to form HBK (Hottinger Brüel & Kjær). With over 3,500 employees worldwide, production facilities in Denmark, Germany, the UK, the USA, China, and Portugal, and a presence in 80 countries, HBK is a global leader in test and measurement solutions. Learn more at https://www.hbkworld.com.

At Lumera, we’re helping some of Europe’s leading Life and Pensions providers modernise their technology, unlock the value of their data, and prepare for an AI-driven future.

Data and Analytics is a strategic growth area for Lumera. We see a significant opportunity to help our clients move beyond traditional reporting towards data-driven decision making, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled services.

Core Accountability

  • You’ve identified and scoped new product opportunities
  • You’ve shipped at least one working MVP with real users
  • You’ve driven adoption and measurable impact

jobDescription:

The role is that of a Regional Coverage Manager, responsible for business development, originating new business and growing the regional presence of the bank.  A sector and life-stage agnostic role, giving the individual ultimate flexibility in being able to support the Innovation ecosystem (from Early-Stage banking right through to Late-Stage lending opportunities).

Reporting to the Head of Regional Coverage, this role will be based in either Bristol or Bath, with a remit to originate in the West of England and Wales eco-systems.  Candidates with strong connections and the ability to maintain a consistent physical presence in this region would be highly advantageous.

Principal, Product Management

Location: London - Hybrid

Role Summary

Nebula is Pearson’s enterprise Product Design System: a shared platform of reusable components, semantic tokens, standards, tooling, and governance that enables product teams to build high-quality, accessible, brand-aligned and AI-ready experiences faster.

Pearson has already demonstrated the value of this model through PLS, including measurable reductions in component-development effort, embedded WCAG 2.2 accessibility, and faster enterprise-wide change. The next challenge is scaling Nebula from a successful system into a durable enterprise capability adopted across Pearson’s products and business units.

As Principal Product Manager for Nebula , you are the senior product leader responsible for turning Nebula’s enterprise vision into an outcome-driven platform roadmap, adoption strategy, and measurable business value .

You partner closely with the Director of Design Systems , who leads Nebula’s system vision, experience and craft strategy, standards, governance, and design/engineering capability. Together, you operate Nebula as an enterprise product—not a component library or downstream service.

Your focus is to make sure Pearson is building the right shared capabilities, for the right consuming teams, in the right sequence—and that adoption produces measurable value.

What You Own

1. Enterprise Product Strategy & Roadmap

Translate Nebula’s enterprise vision into an evidence-led product strategy and prioritized multi-year roadmap.

You will:

  • Co-own the enterprise Nebula roadmap with the Design Systems Director, translating system strategy into product outcomes, initiatives and sequencing.

  • Define the problems Nebula should solve across Pearson’s business units and product portfolios.

  • Prioritize investments across reusable components, platform capabilities, adoption tooling, AI-enabled workflows, Platinum/brand integration and emerging Content/AI needs.

  • Establish clear product hypotheses, success measures and decision criteria before major investments.

  • Balance enterprise standardization against legitimate product and technical differences across consuming teams.

  • Maintain a transparent roadmap connecting investment capabilities adoption measurable enterprise value.

2. Adoption Product Strategy & BU Onboarding

Treat adoption as a product problem , not a communications or change-management exercise.

You will:

  • Segment Pearson products and business units by readiness, compatibility, value opportunity and migration complexity.

  • Partner with BU Product and Engineering leaders to turn interested teams into roadmap-committed adopters with named products, dates, owners and scope .

  • Lead discovery with consuming teams to understand adoption friction, unmet platform needs and migration barriers.

  • Design the end-to-end Nebula adoption experience: evaluation commitment onboarding migration contribution ongoing consumption.

  • Define scalable pilots and onboarding models before expanding enterprise-wide.

  • Use adoption feedback to shape platform roadmap priorities.

  • Partner with Program Management on intake and migration sequencing while retaining product accountability for what and why .

3. Outcomes, Telemetry & Value Measurement

Own the evidence that proves Nebula is working.

You will:

  • Establish the Nebula measurement framework with leading and lagging indicators.

  • Define telemetry for:

  • active products using Nebula

  • component reuse

  • avoided bespoke rebuilds

  • adoption and migration velocity

  • accessibility readiness

  • design-to-code fidelity

  • rebrand propagation time

  • product-development capacity released

  • Create dashboards that allow the central team, BU teams and executives to see adoption and value.

  • Validate assumptions in the business case against real adoption data.

  • Use evidence to stop, change or accelerate investments.

  • Build the product-level evidence required to continuously strengthen Nebula’s enterprise investment case.

4. Discovery & Platform Customer Insight

Build continuous discovery into the operation of the design system.

Your “customers” include designers and engineers, but also Product leaders, accessibility teams, AI teams, Brand, and business units consuming the platform.

You will:

  • Run ongoing generative and evaluative discovery with consuming teams.

  • Identify recurring problems that should become shared enterprise capabilities rather than local solutions.

  • Determine where standardization creates leverage and where flexibility is required.

  • Validate high-value component, workflow and platform opportunities before committing significant central-team capacity.

  • Create feedback mechanisms that allow BU contributions and needs to flow back into Nebula.

  • Turn qualitative customer insight and telemetry into roadmap decisions.

The original Principal PM role’s strength in continuous discovery should stay; its purpose simply shifts from coaching other PMs to directly improving Nebula.

5. Prioritization & Product Operating Model

Create the product discipline that allows a specialized platform team to make high-quality trade-offs.

You will:

  • Own Nebula prioritization and outcome-based backlog management.

  • Establish clear criteria for:

  • platform investments

  • component requests

  • migrations

  • contribution proposals

  • exceptions

  • enterprise versus BU-specific work

  • Partner with the Director, Principal Engineer and discipline leads on roadmap and release planning.

  • Ensure roadmap commitments reflect available team capacity and enterprise value.

  • Convert ambiguous enterprise asks into appropriately sized discovery and delivery increments.

  • Maintain decision traceability from customer problem investment outcome.

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

jobDescription:

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production software systems at scale.
  • Proficiency in Python and or Java or Scala, with computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed data processing, such as Spark, and building data pipelines in batch and or streaming patterns.
  • Experience with Databricks, Amazon Redshift, or equivalent enterprise data warehouse and lakehouse platforms, including designing and tuning performant workloads.
  • Proficiency in SQL and understanding of data modeling and analytics patterns.
  • Practical knowledge of cloud engineering concepts, including security, networking basics, IAM and access controls, encryption, and observability.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot production issues and drive operational improvements.
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with globally distributed teams.
     

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Experience in Markets technology, including familiarity with the trade lifecycle, market risk measures, sensitivities, and P&L explain, plus common products such as FX, rates, credit, and equities.

  • Experience with governance, controls, and data quality frameworks including reconciliations, lineage, auditability, and entitlements.
  • Familiarity with lake and lakehouse table formats and concepts, including Iceberg or Delta, and columnar storage formats such as Parquet.
  • Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerized workloads, and DevOps practices.
  • Experience leading initiatives across multiple teams, including technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-team coordination.
