jobTitle: Senior Software Product Manager (Radio Spectrum sensor systems)
jobDescription:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Product Management


Job Description

About CRFS

CRFS, part of Motorola Solutions, is a world leader in radio frequency (RF) technology, providing mission-critical solutions for defence, national security, and regulatory agencies. Our RFeye ecosystem - including ruggedized sensors, direction-finding arrays, and advanced software suites - allows our customers to detect, identify, and geolocate signals of interest in the most complex electromagnetic environments. We operate at the cutting edge of spectrum dominance, electronic warfare, and signal intelligence.

The Role

We have an opportunity for a Senior Software Product Manager to bridge the gap between complex engineering capabilities and real-world customer missions. This is not a "pure" product management role; it also requires some technical understanding of embedded and application software, as well as familiarity with electronic systems for RF mission applications.

You will be the "voice of the system", working closely with our engineering teams to develop innovative solutions to high-stakes problems. You will take ownership for some of our software products (both current and future), ensuring they not only have clear development roadmaps, but also solve the challenges faced by our global customer base and are the best they can be.

Key Responsibilities

  • Software Solutions: Translate customer and partner requirements into actionable software product roadmaps and specifications, working collaboratively with Senior Engineering, Sales and Product Management colleagues.
  • Product Owner:  As the owner and lead for Software Products (application and embedded) you will maintain a coherent roadmap across all software components, including real-time user applications, embedded real-time, APIs, and user-interfaces.  You will develop promotional content for the marketing team, and provide occasional support at trade events.
  • Product Lifecycle Management (PLM): Support the technical evolution of our RFeye products from concept through to deployment and end-of-life.  Contribute to PLM activities to ensure that RFeye products meet customer requirements, are positioned and marketed effectively and that the CRFS Sales, Customer Support and Application Engineering teams are fully equipped and trained to sell and support them.
  • Bridge Engineering & Commercial: Work alongside software and systems engineers to evaluate trade-offs, ensuring that engineering efforts align with market needs and commercial viability.
  • Market & Application Insight: Develop a deep understanding of use-cases, including TDOA/AOA geolocation, signal capture and analysis, and electronic warfare support.
  • Hands-on Product User:  You will be expected to use our products and become proficient in their use with a view to ensuring they are the best they can be – forming your own judgement on capabilities, improvements and updates using ‘customer eyes’.  You will also engage with end users to elicit their input and feedback.
  • Documentation & Training: Author high-quality white papers, requirement specifications, and user stories. Ensure the Field Application Engineering (FAE) team is fully equipped to demonstrate new system capabilities.


Basic Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: A degree in Engineering (software/electronic/systems preferable) or a related technical field.
  • Industry Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in a technical role, ideally within Wireless/RF, Telecommunications, Defence, or Aerospace.
  • Technical Literacy: Strong foundational knowledge of RF systems (receivers, antennas, signal processing) and wireless communications.
  • User and Solution Mindset: Proven ability to move beyond "features" and think about customer needs and solutions - how hardware and software interact to solve a specific end-user problem.  A demonstrable ability to understand and discuss technical concepts, manage trade-offs, and evaluate opportunistic new ideas against current commitments alongside cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Communication and Approach:  Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. A positive attitude and ability to get things done, whilst being a committed team player.  An ability to build strong relationships and collaborate with colleagues and clients on product requirements and specifications.
  • Product Management: While we welcome engineers looking to transition, prior experience in product management, technical sales support, or systems engineering is highly desirable.
     

Desirable Skills

  • Direct experience with Spectrum Monitoring or Electronic Warfare (EW) applications.
  • Understanding of deployable equipment use within a harsh or military environments and modern user interfaces.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools like Jira.
  • The ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders or customers.
  • Source, compile and analyse market, voice of customer and competitor information.

Under 10%

Experienced

Job Title: Technical Product Owner – Healthcare IoT & Connected Solutions


Role Overview

We are seeking a Technical Product Owner to drive the development and delivery of connected healthcare solutions, working closely with Solution Architects, engineering, and customer service teams. This role bridges business, clinical operations, and engineering—owning product direction while translating real-world healthcare service needs into scalable, secure, and usable solutions.


Although this position is listed as a UK-based role, we welcome applications from candidates located elsewhere in Europe and will consider suitably qualified applicants across the region.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the product roadmap and backlog for healthcare IoT and connected device solutions
  • Translate customer service workflows and field operations needs into product features and technical requirements
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to align product vision with system architecture
  • Define user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements for engineering teams
  • Prioritize features based on business value, operational impact, and customer experience
  • Drive development of solutions supporting device monitoring, diagnostics, remote support, and service automation
  • Collaborate with customer service, support, and field teams to improve issue resolution and service efficiency
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and HITECH Act in product design
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives)
  • Validate delivered features through UAT, field feedback, and operational metrics
  • Drive integration with EHR/EMR systems, service platforms, and IoT ecosystems
  • Partner with DevOps teams to ensure smooth releases, monitoring, and continuous improvement
  • Track and improve KPIs such as uptime, response time, MTTR (mean time to resolution), and customer satisfaction

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in product ownership, product management, or technical program delivery
  • Strong understanding of healthcare customer service operations (support workflows, ticketing systems, field service)
  • Hands-on experience or strong understanding of IoT / connected devices and edge-to-cloud architectures
  • Technical background in software development or engineering (ability to work closely with developers and understand trade-offs)
  • Experience working with APIs, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and backlog management tools (Jira, Azure DevOps)
  • Understanding of NoSQL data stores (e.g., Elasticsearch) and data-driven applications
  • Strong ability to translate business needs into technical requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare environments (hospital systems, medical devices, digital health platforms)
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR, DICOM)
  • Experience with service management platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce Health Cloud, etc.)
  • Exposure to DevOps practices (CI/CD, monitoring, release management)
  • Experience with remote device management, telemetry, and diagnostics systems
  • Background in AI/analytics use cases (predictive maintenance, support automation, knowledge systems)

Key Competencies

  • Strong understanding of customer service workflows in healthcare environments
  • Ability to balance technical depth with product and user experience focus
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and driving clarity
  • Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, operations, and clinical teams
  • Data-driven decision-making with focus on operational efficiency and customer outcomes
  • Ownership mindset with ability to drive product from concept to delivery

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to work on high-impact data initiatives that support a global healthcare business. You'll play a key role in building the foundations for advanced analytics, self-service reporting and AI-driven decision-making while working with modern cloud technologies and a highly collaborative team.


If you're passionate Technical Product Owner who thrives when driving the development and delivery of connected healthcare solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

The Head of Customer Advocacy is responsible for developing and executing customer advocacy programs that strengthen market credibility, validate product positioning, and support commercialization across the Digital Oncology portfolio.
This role serves as the strategic bridge between customers and the business, ensuring customer insights, clinical evidence, outcomes data, and customer experiences are translated into compelling market narratives, validated marketing claims, differentiated go-to-market strategies, and measurable business impact.
The Head of Customer Advocacy will lead advisory boards, customer advocacy programs, consortium initiatives, evidence generation efforts, claims validation processes, and customer reference strategies while partnering closely with Product Marketing, Commercial Strategy, Clinical, Product Management, Communications, Regional Marketing, Regional Sales, Strategic Partnership Managers (SPMs), and Executive Leadership teams.
The role will serve as a central point of coordination between global marketing teams and customer-facing field organizations to ensure customer advocacy, evidence generation, and collaborative innovation initiatives support both global strategy and regional commercial priorities.

Are you passionate about transforming customer relationships into strategic business impact? In this highly visible global role, you'll partner with leading oncology organisations, clinicians, executives, and internal stakeholders to build advocacy programmes, advisory boards, evidence-generation initiatives, and customer communities that directly influence product strategy, commercial growth, and the future of cancer care technology.

This is a unique opportunity to shape how the voice of the customer influences the future of Digital Oncology worldwide. You'll build and lead global customer advocacy programmes, work directly with senior healthcare leaders and oncology experts, generate evidence that supports commercial success, and ensure customer insights help drive product innovation, market strategy, and thought leadership across the business.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Advocacy Strategy


  • Develop and execute the customer advocacy strategy across the Digital Oncology portfolio.
  • Build and maintain a network of customer champions, references, and advocates across oncology provider organizations, health systems, and strategic accounts.
  • Establish scalable advocacy programs that support commercialization, customer engagement, and market differentiation.
  • Ensure the voice of the customer is consistently represented across marketing, product, and commercial initiatives.

Advisory Boards


  • Own the strategy, governance, planning, and execution of Digital Oncology advisory board.
  • Develop annual engagement plans aligned with product strategy, market priorities, and customer needs.
  • Recruit, engage, and maintain relationships with key oncology stakeholders, clinical leaders, and executive customers.
  • Partner with regional sales and marketing teams to identify strategic customer participants and ensure global representation across advisory activities.
  • Translate customer feedback into actionable recommendations for Product Marketing, Product Management, Commercial Strategy, and Executive Leadership.

Clinical Evidence & Outcomes Validation


  • Lead initiatives to gather customer-driven clinical, operational, and business evidence supporting Digital Oncology solutions and services.
  • Partner with clinical, product, and commercial teams to identify evidence-generation opportunities.
  • Develop customer case studies, workflow analyses, outcomes assessments, value realization studies, and ROI frameworks.
  • Create and maintain an evidence repository supporting commercialization, customer engagement, and market positioning.

Marketing Claims Validation & Governance


  • Establish and manage processes for validating product and marketing claims.
  • Partner with Legal, Clinical, Regulatory, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure all external claims are evidence-based, supportable, and compliant.
  • Maintain supporting documentation and governance processes for commercial messaging and customer-facing materials.
  • Ensure alignment between customer outcomes, product capabilities, and market positioning.

Consortiums & Customer Collaboration Programs


  • Lead the development and operation of customer consortiums and collaborative innovation programs.
  • Define program objectives, governance models, participation frameworks, and engagement strategies.
  • Facilitate collaboration between customers and internal stakeholders to advance innovation, workflow optimization, and evidence generation.
  • Capture and disseminate insights that inform product strategy, commercialization priorities, and customer success initiatives.

Customer Reference & Thought Leadership Programs


  • Develop programs that increase customer participation in speaking engagements, conferences, publications, webinars, advisory activities, and industry events.
  • Partner with Communications and Marketing teams to amplify customer stories and thought leadership opportunities.
  • Support executive and customer-facing events by identifying advocacy opportunities and customer participation strategies.

Executive Customer Engagement


  • Partner with Sales Operations and Customer Engagement teams to define the strategic objectives, content, and customer outcomes for VIP customer visits, Customer Experience Center engagements, and executive briefing programs.
  • Ensure customer engagement experiences reinforce product value, market differentiation, and long-term advocacy development.
  • Identify opportunities to convert executive customer engagements into advocacy, evidence generation, and strategic partnership opportunities.

Cross-Functional & Regional Collaboration


  • Collaborate closely with Product Marketing to ensure customer insights and evidence support positioning, messaging, launches, and commercialization strategies.
  • Partner with Commercial Strategy to align advocacy programs with growth initiatives and strategic priorities.
  • Work closely with Product Management to incorporate customer feedback into product planning and roadmap discussions.
  • Coordinate with Regional Marketing and Regional Sales teams to identify customer advocacy opportunities, recruit program participants, and activate customer success stories across global markets.
  • Partner closely with Strategic Partnership Managers (SPMs) to identify, engage, and develop strategic customer relationships that support consortiums, collaborative innovation programs, advisory boards, and evidence-generation initiatives.
  • Support SPMs in cultivating executive customer relationships that advance both customer value and broader business objectives.
  • Coordinate with Communications, Clinical, and Executive Leadership teams to maximize the impact of customer advocacy initiatives and thought leadership programs.



Qualifications



Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Life Sciences, Radiotherapy or a related field.
  • Experience in customer advocacy, product marketing, healthcare marketing, commercialization, clinical strategy, or related functions.
  • Experience working within healthcare technology, oncology, digital health, SaaS, clinical software, or healthcare services organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading advisory boards, customer advocacy programs, or evidence-generation initiatives.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to engage senior healthcare leaders, clinicians, and strategic customers.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in oncology, radiation oncology, medical oncology, or healthcare workflow technology.
  • Familiarity with clinical evidence generation, outcomes research, value realization programs, or claims substantiation processes.
  • Experience supporting SaaS, on-premise software, managed services, or healthcare technology solutions.
  • Experience managing customer reference programs, thought leadership initiatives, consortiums, or collaborative innovation programs.

Success Metrics


  • Growth and engagement of customer advocacy network.
  • Number and quality of customer references, case studies, and evidence assets generated.
  • Effectiveness of advisory boards
  • Contribution of customer evidence to commercialization and market positioning efforts.
  • Adoption of validated claims and governance processes.
  • Customer participation in thought leadership and advocacy activities.
  • Impact of customer insights on product strategy and commercialization initiatives.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, POM Product Owner, to join our BNY Payments Enablement Enterprise Platform team. This role is located in Manchester, UK. 

  

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: 

The Product Owner will lead the Liquidity Management pod in the Core Processor Group, which is one of the groups within the BNY Payments Enablement Enterprise Platform with the mission to own the execution, orchestration, and lifecycle management of payments across the Payments Enablement Platform, ensuring payments are processed accurately, consistently, and resiliently regardless of rail, product, or channel. This group defines and delivers the core payment behavior that sits between payment intake and payment rail execution.  

Key responsibilities of the Product Owner would be to manage the Liquidity Management pod within the Core Processor group, including 

  • Own and manage the product backlog for the pod, ensuring alignment with platform OKRs and strategic priorities.  

  • Drive product outcomes that strengthen intraday liquidity visibility, funding efficiency, payment prioritization, and control effectiveness across the payment lifecycle. 

  • Partner with business, operations, treasury, risk, and technology teams to evolve liquidity management capabilities that support resilient payment processing and effective exception handling. 

  • Identify opportunities to improve product delivery and operational decision-making through responsible use of data, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities. 

  • Translate complex business needs into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria.  

  • Prioritize backlog items to balance new feature delivery, technical debt, and platform resiliency.  

  • Lead sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives in partnership with the Scrum Leads and development team.  

  • Ensure solution designs align with long-term architecture and platform vision.  

  • Monitor and measure pod’s performance, using data to inform decisions and continuous improvement. 

  • Ensure timely and accurate delivery of payment related information to internal Lines of Business (LoBs), external clients, 3rd party providers and market infrastructures enabling smooth operations, maintaining client trust, and supporting compliance

The Director, Devices & Micro Product is responsible for leading a portfolio of >$150M within Lab Filtration, spanning devices, microbiology and collection solutions that customers rely on to support critical research, life science manufacturing, and applied market workflows. This leader will shape the strategy, performance, and growth of the portfolio, driving customer value, innovation, and commercial execution across a global business.


This position reports to the VP, GM Diagnostics & Genomics and Lab Filtration and is part of the D&G & LF leadership team, part of Discovery and Medical Operating company located in Cardiff (UK), Amersham (UK) or Marlborough (US) offices and will be an on-site role


What you will do:

• Develop and execute the strategic plan for the Lab Filtration Devices & Micro portfolio, owning the end-to-end product strategy across growth, profitability, lifecycle management, and market positioning.

• Ensure portfolio performance delivers against CVD and key business KPIs, leading PSP problem-solving to identify root causes and implement countermeasures across the portfolio.

• Contribute to the overall strategic direction of the Lab Filtration business and the broader D&G & LF leadership agenda as a member of the leadership team.

• Drive the innovation pipeline for Devices & Micro, ensuring a clear flow of customer-backed projects that meet IFV/IPV targets and strengthen the long-term competitiveness of the portfolio.

• Partner cross-functionally with R&D, operations, quality, supply chain, and commercial teams to deliver successful NPD execution, product launches, and lifecycle initiatives.

• Build strong segment and customer insight to identify opportunities in lab filtration, microbiology, and sample preparation workflows, translating market needs into clear portfolio actions.

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 5 direct reports, fostering a high-performance culture with clear priorities, strong accountability, and regular feedback.



Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Business, or a related field
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, marketing, or portfolio leadership, preferably within life sciences, lab filtration, bioprocessing, microbiology, applied markets, or related consumables and devices portfolios
  • Experience working cross-functionally with R&D, operations, quality, supply chain, and commercial teams to deliver new product development (NPD) and lifecycle management initiatives
  • Experience leading and developing teams, including direct management of product management teams
  • Demonstrated experience managing product portfolios with P&L responsibility and delivering against revenue and margin targets in a global B2B environment

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel internationally – up to 35% of the time and up to consecutive weeks

Job Description

Are you interested in delivering impactful business results? In this newly established global role, you will lead the successful delivery and adoption of strategic capabilities across Global Commercial Operations (GCO).  Working across Demand Planning, Order Management, Performance Management, and Product and Digital teams, you will ensure new processes, operating models, and ways of working are successfully implemented, adopted, and embedded within the organization. 

The role combines business delivery leadership, organizational readiness, change execution, and capability development to help GCO continuously evolve and improve how it operates – what an amazing job opportunity, is not it?

Core Responsibilities:

Lead Strategic Business Delivery

  • Lead delivery of major GCO initiatives and operating model changes.
  • Translate strategic priorities into executable plans and measurable business outcomes.
  • Coordinate delivery across functions and stakeholders to ensure successful execution.

Drive Organizational Readiness and Adoption

  • Lead business readiness, change management, and adoption activities for new processes and ways of working.
  • Ensure teams are prepared to successfully operate within future-state operating models.
  • Partner with Digital Deployment Managers to align business adoption with technology deployments.

Build and Embed Organizational Capabilities

  • Identify capability gaps and develop training, enablement, and capability-building plans across GCO.
  • Ensure new capabilities, processes, and ways of working become embedded within day-to-day operations.
  • Support the continued evolution of Demand Planning, Order Management, and Performance Management capabilities.

Strengthen Delivery Excellence

  • Establish consistent approaches for project delivery, change management, business readiness, and implementation.
  • Develop frameworks, tools, and best practices that improve execution effectiveness across GCO initiatives.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment and remove barriers to successful implementation.

Realize Business Value From Change

  • Ensure strategic initiatives deliver their intended business outcomes.
  • Monitor adoption and identify barriers preventing realization of expected benefits.
  • Partner with Commercial Operations Performance to measure impact and drive corrective actions where required.

Play your part in our team succeeding

Global Commercial Operations is responsible for how demand is planned, how orders are managed, and how performance is improved across the LEGO Group. As GCO continues to evolve through initiatives such as Aurora, Quote-to-Fulfill, and future process improvements, success depends not only on defining the right processes and technologies, but also on ensuring they are successfully adopted and embedded within the organization. This role plays a critical role in bridging strategy and execution by helping the business successfully implement new capabilities, adopt new ways of working, and realize intended business outcomes.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Significant experience leading large-scale business transformation, operating model change, or strategic capability-building initiatives
  • Strong program and project delivery experience, including managing complex cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
  • Practical experience in Demand Planning, Order Management, Commercial Planning, Supply Chain, or a related business function
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategic objectives into executable implementation plans and measurable business outcomes
  • Experience leading organizational readiness, change management, business adoption, and capability-building activities
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior leaders
  • Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, navigate organizational change, and drive execution across complex environments
  • Experience building training, enablement, or capability-development programs
  • Professional certification in Project Management (PMP, PRINCE2), Change Management (Prosci), Lean, Agile, or similar methodologies
  • Experience working in a global consumer products, retail, or omnichannel business environment

The ideal candidate will be organised, proactive and confident managing multiple projects at once. You will be expected to take ownership of your productions, anticipate issues early, uphold high production standards, and ensure shoots and deliveries run smoothly. You must have a strong creative eye, a clear understanding of our brands’ visual identities and tone of voice, and the ability to adapt your approach across different disciplines and commercial requirements.

  • Manage commercial shoots end-to-end, from pitch support to final delivery.
  • Scope and manage production budgets, schedules and logistics.
  • Lead clear briefings throughout production, keeping all stakeholders aligned on deliverables, timelines and budgets.
  • Handle bookings and negotiations for crew, locations, studios, suppliers and talent (including usage and contracts).

  • Oversee post-production, including edits, retouching, grading and asset rights.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of brand identities and audience expectations, recommending formats, approaches and platform requirements during pitch development.

Position overview 

Autodesk Customer Technical Success is looking for an experienced Design & Manufacturing customer advocate to identify the systemic customer problems that matter most and turn those signals into clear decisions and measurable outcomes. 


The Customer Advocate brings together customer advocacy and product intelligence skills into one role. You will bring Design & Manufacturing product and workflow knowledge together with customer conversations, support trends, escalations, product data, sentiment, and business context to understand what is really happening, determine where Autodesk should invest attention, and build a clear case for action.   


Your value comes from applying technical expertise and judgment to customer signals, developing a point of view, validating it with customers and internal partners, and driving systemic issues toward a clear solution path. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Technical Support, Technical Account Management, Support Readiness, Customer Success, and other teams across Autodesk. 


Responsibilities 

  • Identify, validate, and prioritize systemic customer pain using Support data, customer conversations, escalations, telemetry, sentiment, and other signals, distinguishing isolated incidents from issues with broader or growing impact
  • Build a clear understanding of Design & Manufacturing customer workflows and validate customer pain directly with customers, account teams, Technical Account Managers, Support specialists, and other relevant partners
  • Build decision-ready Reliability Packages that combine customer evidence, quantitative data, business impact, and strategic context
  • Develop a point of view on potential solution paths, including Product or Engineering changes, diagnostics, supportability improvements, workflow guidance, digital solutions, communications, or other approaches
  • Connect systemic customer pain to Autodesk and Product strategic priorities so teams can make informed decisions about where investment can create the greatest customer and business value
  • Drive prioritized issues toward a clear decision and accountable owner, and escalate when ownership or alignment cannot be established
  • Help bring structure to complex work by getting the right people aligned, making ownership clear, and keeping priority issues moving forward
  • Build trusted relationships with Design & Manufacturing Product Management and Engineering teams and bring customer intelligence into roadmap, reliability, planning, and prioritization discussions
  • Use strategic customer escalations as a source of intelligence when they expose systemic risk, significant customer impact, or problems likely to scale, without replacing standard account or Support escalation processes
  • Represent the voice of the customer through direct engagement, advisory groups, support interactions, customer sentiment, community signals, and other feedback channels
  • Partner with Support Readiness to translate decisions, workarounds, Product changes, and resolved customer pain into scalable guidance for customer-facing teams and, where appropriate, customers
  • Follow prioritized issues through the Reliability value chain and evaluate whether the resulting Product, supportability, or operational action reduced customer pain
  • Use modern data, analytics, and AI-assisted tools to accelerate signal identification and synthesis while applying human judgment and product expertise to conclusions and recommendations



Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support, technical account management, customer advocacy, product insights, product operations, product management, or a related customer-facing or product-facing discipline
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Autodesk Fusion, Autodesk Inventor, or comparable professional CAD/CAM software, with the ability to understand complex Design & Manufacturing workflows, product behavior, and technical customer issues
  • Strong analytical judgment and pattern-recognition skills, with the ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative information and make recommendations with incomplete or ambiguous data
  • Experience developing compelling business cases or problem narratives that connect evidence, customer impact, business impact, and recommended action
  • Demonstrated ability to independently structure and lead ambiguous, cross-functional work, align stakeholders and dependencies, and influence Product Management, Engineering, and senior leaders without direct authority
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex customer and technical problems for Product and executive audiences
  • Ability to prioritize a limited number of high-impact issues and maintain focus in an environment with competing customer, Product, and organizational demands
  • Comfort using modern data, analytics, and AI-assisted tools to investigate customer signals and develop an informed point of view

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience working directly with Product Management and Engineering on product quality, reliability, defect prioritization, or roadmap decisions
  • Experience supporting strategic or enterprise Design & Manufacturing customers and understanding the technical and business context behind high-impact customer issues
  • Broader familiarity with Design & Manufacturing workflows such as CAD, CAM, data management, collaboration, or manufacturing processes
  • Experience with customer advisory programs, Voice of Customer programs, systemic issue management, or problem-management practices
  • Experience developing scalable approaches that reduce recurring customer issues or improve product and customer experience outcomes

jobTitle: Head of Forward Deployed Engineering EMEA
jobDescription:
Working at Atlassian

Your future team

As a Head of Forward Deployed Engineering EMEA at Atlassian, you’ll be at the forefront of applied AI, working directly with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, AI-powered solutions. The FDE team partners with top organizations across industries, helping them leverage Atlassian’s AI capabilities to solve complex, real-world problems. You’ll collaborate with product, engineering, and design, rapidly growing your technical and domain expertise while making a tangible impact on business outcomes. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for those who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are passionate about shaping the future of AI-powered teamwork.

What you’ll do

As a Head of Forward Deployed Engineering EMEA, you will:

  • Hire, onboard, and retain top talent for your team and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.

  • Mentor and coach your forward-deployed engineering team on best practices in AI/ML solution design, code quality, scalable architecture, testing, debugging, and documentation—ensuring rapid, high-quality delivery of customer-focused, production-ready solutions.

  • Drive data-driven solution development by analyzing complex datasets to extract insights and inform product direction.

  • Champion the adoption of AI-augmented workflow automation within customer environments, maximizing business value and operational efficiency.

  • Oversee the end-to-end deployment of AI solutions into production, ensuring continuous evaluation, monitoring, and improvement.

  • Navigate risk and compliance requirements, including AI risk assessment, data privacy (GDPR), and regulatory frameworks.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, creating concise artifacts for peers, partners, and leadership.

  • Align technical solutions with business objectives, setting a clear vision for technological progress and measurable results.

Your background

On the first day, we'll expect you to have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of experience managing software engineering teams at scale.

  • Experience delivering impactful AI/ML solutions in production environments, including experience as a founding or forward-deployed engineer in 0-to-1 product development.

  • Deep expertise in applied AI/ML, including generative AI, LLMs, and agent-based frameworks.

  • Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, and experience with APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration.

  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems and thrive in rapidly changing environments.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority.

  • Experience with AI risk assessment, data privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR).

  • Strategic and innovative thinking, with a track record of aligning technical solutions to business goals.

It's great, but not required, if you have:

  • Experience with Atlassian Intelligence, Rovo AI, or AI-powered Atlassian features.

  • Familiarity with regulated industries (e.g., finance, healthcare).

  • Experience deploying AI solutions to complex production systems at scale.

  • Prior experience mentoring or leading engineering teams.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

In this role, you'll be part of the Customer Success Architect team within the Sales and Success department, focusing on the adoption of Atlassian's AI platform, Rovo. As a CSA (AI), you'll execute time-boxed, co-built technical engagements that take customers from "Rovo is turned on" to real, measurable business value in production. You'll partner directly with enterprise teams to discover high-impact AI use cases, design and build custom Rovo agents, configure third-party connectors, and deploy working solutions into production workflows. Your work will involve managing engagements, enabling customers, and continuously improving processes to enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

CSAs are accomplished at delivering performant technical guidance at scale, aligning product capabilities with business needs and desired outcomes. This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Your background

  • Technical Aptitude: Experience with AI platforms, the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, Rovo), and technical product demos. Familiarity with building AI agents, prompt engineering, and configuring integrations between enterprise knowledge sources and AI systems. Hands-on experience helping organizations adopt and operationalize AI tools in production environments.

  • Solution Area Expertise: Specialized knowledge in enterprise workflows across product development, IT service management, or business operations. Understanding how AI agents and automation can improve processes such as incident response, backlog management, knowledge discovery, and cross-team collaboration. Familiarity with third-party connector ecosystems (Google Drive, SharePoint, Slack, GitHub, etc.).

  • Product Mindset & Communication: Strong product mindset, able to shape technical solutions for business impact, and comfortable owning problems end-to-end from discovery to deployment. Effective communicator who can influence stakeholders and explain AI concepts to varied audiences. Delivers durable solutions but can quickly prototype when needed. Ability to translate AI capabilities into tangible outcomes for non-technical stakeholders.

The Head of Customer Success, EMEA will be responsible for overall revenue retention and product adoption of a large portfolio of customers and ARR, leading and mentoring regional customer success teams across EMEA. You will execute on regional strategy for customer satisfaction, retention and growth in coordination with the global customer success organization and strategy. jobTitle: Select Investment Advisor | S2 | Private Banking and Select Investments | Birmingham
jobDescription:
Select Investment Advisor | S2 | Private Banking and Select Investments | Birmingham

Country: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE

Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.

This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

Retail & Commercial Banking I Digital & Assisted Channels; is a global business integrating all our retail and commercial banking activities to better serve our customers, improve efficiency and drive value creation.

The Private Banking & Select Investment teams are structured to provide regulated advice on financial services and investment products tailored to meet long-term investment needs of the clients within the segment.

THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE

Santander is looking for a Select Investment Advisor based out of Birmingham.

A dream holiday. Early retirement. Sending a loved one to university. Some of our customers have big plans for their money, and that’s where you come in. By providing them with clear informed advice about their investment options, you’ll help to make those plans a reality.

If you have experience in providing customers with investment advice and see your future as a key colleague in our branch network, this could be your opportunity to become a Select Investment Advisor.

It’s a premium service: you’ll be working with customers looking to invest for at least five years or more. You’ll listen to their needs, clarify their objectives and analyse their circumstances. Where appropriate, you’ll explain which of our award-winning investment products are right for them.

We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Providing regulated investment advice to help clients meet their objectives. Representing Santander Select and investments in Branch.

  • Identifying potential new customers in need of this Service.

  • Demonstrating deep understanding of wider financial affairs and financial products to ensure that knowledge is comprehensive, and client focused.

  • Maintaining up to date and compliant records to ensure relevant internal standards and external regulatory requirements are observed.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Professional Experience:

  • Proven skills in providing investment advice and delivering an outstanding customer experience (Required)

  • A good knowledge and understanding of wider financial markets, with exposure to the full range of banking products and financial planning in-dustry (Preferred)

Education:

  • A Level 4 Financial Planning diploma valid for FCA activity 4 (giving personal recommendations on retail investment products) (Required)

Hard Skills:

  • Investment Market and Product Knowledge (Required)

  • Financial Software navigation skills (Required)

  • Regulatory and compliance knowledge, specifically consumer duty (Required)

  • Relationship Management (Required)

  • Communication and Influencing Skills (Required)

  • Proactive and dynamic approach to change (Required)

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT

Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.

  • Salary Range: 

  • £47,142.00 - £70,714.00 per annum (depending on experience)

  • This salary range represents the expected remuneration for the role. Annual salary is based on a standard 35-hour working week. Actual salary offered will depend on skills, experience, qualifications and location.

  • We put 8% of salary into your pension, even if you don’t contribute yourself. We’ll pay in up to 12.5% of salary, if you contribute as well, and you can take some of our contribution in cash if you prefer.

  • Protection for you and your family, with company-funded death-in-service benefit and income protection insurance, and the option to take advantage of discounted rates for additional life assurance and critical illness cover.

  • Share in Santander’s success by saving or investing in our share plans.

  • Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring.

Heidelberg Materials UK (formerly Hanson UK) is one of the UK’s largest suppliers of construction materials, employing over 4,000 people and operating around 300 manufacturing sites in the UK.

We are committed to building a more sustainable future and recognise that a diverse workforce is vital to our growth and advancement. We aim to promote a culture that values openness, transparency and individual achievement.

At the centre of our actions lies the responsibility for the environment. As the front runner on the path to carbon neutrality and circular economy in the building materials industry, we are working on sustainable building materials and solutions for the future. We enable new opportunities for our customers through digitalisation.

Production Supervisor


Lead Operations. Drive Performance. Make a Difference.


At Heidelberg Materials, we're looking for an enthusiastic and proactive Production Supervisor to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated individual to take a key leadership role in ensuring the safe, efficient, and profitable operation of one of our quarry sites.

Working closely with the Site Manager, you'll help oversee day-to-day production activities, lead by example on health and safety, maintain high-quality standards, and support the development of site personnel.

If you're passionate about operational excellence, thrive in a hands-on environment, and enjoy leading people to achieve great results, we'd love to hear from you.


What You'll Be Doing

Health, Safety & Environmental Leadership

  • Champion a strong health and safety culture across the site.
  • Ensure operations comply with all relevant legislation, company policies, and the Heidelberg Materials Health, Safety & Environment Management System.
  • Lead by example in the use of safe working practices, PPE, and site standards.
  • Hold the appointment under Section 8 (1) (d) of the Quarries Regulations 1999.
  • Conduct and review daily site inspections and safety audits.
  • Support the management and monitoring of contractors to ensure safe working practices are followed.
  • Ensure weekly geotechnical inspections are completed and recorded.

Production & Operational Performance

  • Support the Site Manager in delivering safe and efficient quarry operations.
  • Assist with maintenance planning and ensure servicing and repairs are completed to schedule.
  • Help manage plant performance, production activities, and operational resources.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance and operational records.
  • Contribute to period-end reporting, stock returns, production data, and breakdown analysis.

Quality & Customer Service

  • Ensure all products supplied meet required specifications and quality standards.
  • Promote a customer-focused approach across the operation.
  • Work closely with customers, commercial teams, and logistics colleagues to deliver reliable service.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with visitors, customers, and stakeholders.

Team Leadership

  • Support and develop site employees through coaching, training, and mentoring.
  • Ensure all new starters receive appropriate induction and role-specific training.
  • Build positive working relationships across the team and address challenges proactively.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Site Standards & Continuous Improvement

  • Help manage the procurement of materials, services, and site requirements.
  • Support cost control and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Maintain excellent housekeeping standards across the site.
  • Ensure roads, buildings, equipment, and surrounding areas remain safe, compliant, and presentable.
  • Build positive relationships with local communities and support the resolution of any site concerns.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in candidates who can demonstrate:

  • Supervisory or leadership experience within a quarry, aggregates, mining, manufacturing, heavy industry, construction materials, or processing environment.
  • Strong commitment to health, safety, and environmental excellence.
  • Excellent communication and people management skills.
  • Ability to organise workloads, prioritise activities, and make sound operational decisions.
  • Experience managing maintenance activities and operational performance.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • IT literacy and confidence in maintaining operational records and reports.
  • Knowledge of quarry operations and relevant regulations is desirable.

Why Join Heidelberg Materials?

At Heidelberg Materials, we're committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive. We invest in our people, support career progression, and provide opportunities to develop new skills and take on greater responsibility.


You'll be joining a global industry leader with a strong focus on sustainability, innovation, safety, and operational excellence.

Role OverviewAs a Supervisor, you play a key role in supporting the smooth running of the shop floor and delivering the high service standards our customers expect. You play an active role in supporting colleagues throughout each shift, helping to maintain high standards of service, presentation and store performance. You’ll also support daily operational tasks as directed by Store Management.

Key Responsibilities • Deliver excellent customer service by supporting customers, resolving queries, and ensuring team presentation meets brand expectations. • Support sales performance by monitoring service levels, using in-store devices to offer the full product range, and assisting with effective product placement. • Maintain strong visual and operational standards by keeping the shop floor clean, organised, and aligned with brand standards and company expectations. • Assist with daily operational duties including opening and closing procedures, cashing up, and supporting accurate till operations. Skills & Experience Required • Previous supervisory or team-leader experience in fast-paced retail or customer-facing environments. • Strong communication skills with the ability to guide and support colleagues on the shop floor. • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to uphold high standards in service, presentation, and store operations. • Strong interest in retail, solid product and trend awareness, and the ability to promote company values and behaviours. Desirable Attributes • Positive and proactive leader who enjoys supporting colleagues and contributing to a busy retail environment. • Effective problem-solver with strong customer service and resolution skills. • Interest in visual merchandising and product presentation. • Team-focused mindset with a positive, supportive approach.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic individual to join our Accrington team in the position of Production Operative.

The position will provide direction and control within a production environment manufacturing Bricks and Special shape bricks for use in both the commercial and domestic (Housing) Markets.

You will be responsible for the safe and efficient operation of all plant and equipment that you will be trained to use whilst being focused and committed to achieve our aims in delivering excellent quality and customer service.

The job role will involve being trained in various production processes contained within the manufacturing system. These will include our Quarry plant, Clay prep plant, Manufacturing, Sorting & packaging plant associated with brick production, and operating a range of mobile plant.

 

Shift: 4on 4off Days & Nights (12hours)

 

Your duties would include but not limited to the following;

 

            Key accountabilities relating to Health & Safety

  • Maintain high standards of Health & Safety for not only yourself but others whilst engaged in all workplace activities.
  • Ensure all Health & safety standards are adhered to as set out within the sites health & safety management systems.
  • Report all Health & Safety concerns immediately to your line manager.
  • Ensure that risk assessments and safe systems of work for each task / process for which you are trained are strictly adhered to. No tasks to be undertaken where a current and suitable risk assessment /SSOW is not in place.
  • Ensure that PPE issued is kept and maintained in good condition.
  • Ensure that all tools & equipment that you use are kept in good condition, returned to their nominated storage place after use & any defects are reported.
  • Ensure that all guarding is correctly fitted. Report & action any defective equipment immediately.
  • Ensure a permit to work is obtained for high-risk tasks e.g., working at height, entering a confined space working.

 

Key accountabilities relating to Quality Systems

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

In AECOM’s AI Engineering team, your work will help deliver technology that directly shapes the physical world around us. We build AI-driven products that change how infrastructure and buildings are designed and engineered, reducing waste, cutting CO₂, and making the built environment more efficient and sustainable. This role ensures those products and the platforms behind them are reliable, scalable, and secure by design.

With our AI Engineering team we’ve created a unique setup: a lean, highly technical team with the speed and ownership of a start up, backed by the scale, resources, and domain expertise of one of the world’s leading engineering firms.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. We are leading the industry’s AI transformation, and with our people and technology we deliver excellence and innovate with impact.

We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams to solve the world’s most complex challenges. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

What You’ll Do

As part of our AI Engineering team, you will lead the DevSecOps capabilities that help engineers build, release, and operate services across our multi-cloud platform. You will shape CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, reliability, cloud governance, and secure engineering across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will also manage cloud-vendor service reviews, security advisories, escalations, and roadmap discussions.

+ Evolve CI/CD pipelines and reusable workflows that enable fast, reliable, and repeatable testing and deployment, with automated quality and security controls

+ Build observability and operational readiness through monitoring, logging, tracing, runbooks, and incident response, improving the reliability and performance of production services

+ Define and track service reliability objectives, and recovery requirements for production services, using incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.

+ Embed proportionate security into engineering workflows and cloud environments, including platform security reviews, threat modelling, access and secrets management, automated scanning, and vulnerability remediation

+ Monitor cloud security posture across Azure and GCP, helping teams prioritise misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, and remediation work according to risk

+ Manage technical and service relationships with Microsoft, Google Cloud, and other critical vendors, leading service reviews, security advisory responses, escalations, and roadmap and cost discussions

+ Partner with platform, product, and AI/ML engineers on architecture decisions, mentor colleagues, and make clear trade-offs across developer experience, reliability, performance, cost, and security

Qualifications

Must-Have Qualifications

+ Demonstrated hands-on experience across DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, DevSecOps, or related roles, with experience guiding technical decisions or mentoring colleagues

+ Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and release automation, ideally with GitHub Actions or similar tooling

+ Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and cloud platform automation using Terraform

+ Demonstrated ownership of production reliability, including observability, service-level objectives, incident management, post-incident reviews, capacity planning, and disaster-recovery testing.

+ Practical experience carrying out security reviews and implementing controls across identity, secrets management, software supply chains, and vulnerability management

+ Experience working directly with cloud providers or technology vendors, ideally including Microsoft or Google Cloud, on service reviews, escalations, or roadmap discussions

+ Practical experience monitoring and optimising cloud expenditure across large Azure or GCP environments.

Preferred Skills

+ Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service cloud capabilities

+ Experience applying image scanning, artefact signing, or software provenance controls to containerised workloads

+ Familiarity with cloud security posture management, policy-as-code, security monitoring, or compliance automation

+ Experience supporting AI/ML workloads and SaaS platforms in production

Additional Information

Our Hiring Process

+ Take-home challenge: A hands-on task to assess your problem-solving and technical skills

+ Combined technical and cultural interview (in-person)

+ Technical Interview: 1-hour with 2 of our engineers to discuss your solution to the take-home challenge
